category  = Logic
desc      = Shifts TTL or CMOS levels up to VDD.
datasheet = https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/cd4504b.pdf
package   = DIP-16, SOIC-16, TSSOP-16
pins      = VCC AOUT AIN BOUT BIN COUT CIN VSS DIN DOUT EIN EOUT MODE FIN FOUT VDD
ids       = numbers
aliases   = 4504, HEF4504B, MC1504B
